reason: I grab my Monster at the station shop or Albert on the way to a shift, and this isn't sold anywhere I actually walk past. I'm not ordering cans online or going to a bistro just to get my caffeine, especially at 55 a can when a Monster is cheaper and bigger.
objection: 55 CZK for 330 ml and only 80 mg of caffeine, when a 500 ml Monster costs less and kicks harder, and coffee or water does the job anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it was in the fridge at Albert, Tesco or the metro shop for around 40 CZK, I'd try one to see if it actually keeps me going through a shift.
